subject: Allocation corridor & procurement thresholds — Finway pilot (recap + next steps)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@finway.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-12T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Allocation corridor & procurement thresholds — Finway pilot (recap + next steps)

Hi Claire —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared view on spend profile and procurement constraints before I draft the pilot SOW: 

What I heard you say (please correct if I got anything wrong):
- Pilot scope: 3-week integration + 6-week live validation using the transaction enrichment model (sequence lengths ~ 330 tokens average).
- Expected monthly consumption range: ~15M–65M tokens depending on sampling cadence.
- Target unit economics: you were aiming for ~ $750–900 per 1M tokens for the pilot volume (before any reserved-commit discounts).
- Procurement constraints: Finway requires a minimum PO for new vendors — you mentioned a $50k PO is preferred, but finance may need $100k for vendor setup (internal approval gate).

Open items / what we need to lock before I send the SOW:
1) Confirm which monthly spend band you expect to land in during the pilot (lower: 15–30M / mid: 31–50M / upper: 51–65M). This will determine the pricing band and whether a reserved commit makes sense.
2) Confirm PO threshold (is $50k acceptable or do we need to budget for $100k vendor setup?).
3) Any compliance artifacts procurement needs attached to the SOW (example: vendor W9, SOC2 checklist).

Attached: pilot-pricing-sheet.csv (baseline bands + reserve vs PAYG math) and an early SOW draft.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm band + PO preference by EOD Friday 11/14.
- I’ll send updated SOW + a one-page pricing summary for legal/procurement to attach to the PO.

Thanks again — excited to get Finway on a pilot.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
(t) +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachments referenced: Finway_SOW_v2.pdf, pilot-pricing-sheet.csv
From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@finway.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finway.ai
Date: 2025-11-12T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Allocation corridor & procurement thresholds — Finway pilot (recap + next steps)

Thanks Tessa, this is helpful — nicely summarized. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Band: we expect to start in the mid band (31–50M tokens/month) for the first 2 months while we ramp integrations. If the sampling increases after validation we could hit the upper band, but mid is the expectation for procurement.
- Unit economics: $800 per 1M tokens is the target baseline for negotiation on the pilot. If we commit to a 3-month reserved slab we can probably stretch to $700/1M; PAYG will sit higher (~$950/1M).
- PO threshold: our procurement team can issue a $50k PO for pilots, but vendor onboarding (vendor setup + tax forms) often requires a $100k internal threshold to expedite legal review. To be clear — procurement can start the PO at $50k but it may push the legal & account team timeline out by ~10 business days.
- Compliance: procurement asked for a SOC2 summary and standard terms addendum. We’ll send exact email addresses for procurement contact and legal reviewer once we confirm the SOW.

Quick follow-up Qs: could you send a single-line summary of pricing bands with the expected effective $/1M after the most likely discounts for mid-band/3-month commit vs PAYG? That will help our finance lead to triage the PO size.

Claire
Head of Platform Product
Finway.ai

On 2025-11-12 at 14:20, Tessa Morgan wrote:
> Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared view on spend profile and procurement constraints before I draft the pilot SOW...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-13T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Allocation corridor & procurement thresholds — pricing options for Finway

Looping in pricing/ops perspective. Notes on what to offer and finance exposure: 

1) Pricing constructs to present (short bullets to include in the one-pager):
   - PAYG: $950 / 1M tokens (no commit, on-demand) — simple, highest flexibility.
   - Mid-band reserved (31–50M): $700 / 1M with a 3-month minimum commit (monthly true-up allowed).
   - Upper-band reserved (51–65M): $625 / 1M with a 3-month minimum commit + 10% overage kicker.
   - Optional: credit for multi-quarter eligibility (apply 5% credit if they convert to an annual reserved once pilot completes).

2) Procurement/finance risk note: if Finway issues a $50k PO and legal signs it, we need to treat the onboarding as "standard" but keep in mind revenue recognition and refund policies for early termination. If they require vendor setup that triggers our legal review because of the $100k threshold, expect a 7–12 business day delay.

3) Doc & artifact checklist for procurement (attach to SOW):
   - SOC2 summary (one-pager)
   - W9
   - Standard MSLA (redline summary)

Priya — can you add the SOC2 summary and MSLA link to the SOW draft? I’ll update the pricing table and margins so Tessa can send the one-liner that Claire requested.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Final ask: pick the pilot spend band + PO lane (quick)

Hi Claire / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick replies. Attached is an updated one-page pricing summary and a redlined SOW (Finway_SOW_v2.pdf) that includes the artifact checklist Rishi mentioned. To make procurement progress fast, we need two quick confirmations from Finway: 

1) Pilot spend band (choose one):
   - MID_BAND (31–50M tokens/mo) — recommended and expected — Effective price: $700 / 1M tokens (3-month reserved with monthly true-up)
   - PAYG (no commit) — Effective price: $950 / 1M tokens

2) PO lane for vendor onboarding: 
   - Option A: Procurement issues $50k PO now (pilot start earlier; legal review may take longer).
   - Option B: Procurement targets $100k PO to trigger expedited legal/vendor setup (delayed start but faster onboarding once issued).

If you confirm MID_BAND + Option A by EOD Friday 11/14 I will:
- Send DocuSign-ready SOW + pricing summary for signature.
- Provide a single-sheet "procurement packet" (SOC2 one-pager, W9, MSLA link) for your procurement inbox.

HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FIN-2025-1072

Claire — would $700/1M for mid-band work as your target? If so I’ll route the packet and tag procurement for an initial PO.

Thanks —
